concept.name: Ensemble model
concept.definition: A predictor that combines outputs from multiple component models to improve stability, accuracy, or coverage of different patterns.
concept.intuition: It is a learnable mapping or representation used to turn features into predictions or groups.
concept.mechanics: Train diverse base estimators and aggregate their predictions by averaging, voting, weighted blending, or a learned meta-model.
concept.failure_modes: Flexible models can fit noise, shift under new regimes, and conceal instability when tuning is repeated on the same validation data.
concept.misconceptions: Greater model complexity or in-sample accuracy does not by itself imply better out-of-sample trading results.
concept.example: Three return forecasts of 0.2%, -0.1%, and 0.5% are equally averaged into a 0.2% ensemble forecast.
